verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs explicitly describe hard-linking node_modules files from a single content-addressable store so identical versions are stored once on disk ([pnpm-docs-15], [pnpm-docs-28], [pnpm-docs-38]), and this is corroborated by independent community reports of dramatically reduced disk usage across many projects ([pnpm-comm-4]). missing for 10: no hands-on benchmark/proof of exact single-copy storage across multiple real projects, only docs + general community praise.
